text: According to the LTL semantics, when does π, i ⊨ φ U ψ ('φ until ψ') hold?
choices: When ψ holds at position i and φ holds at every later position
When φ holds at every position from i onward and ψ never holds
When φ and ψ both hold at position i
When there is some j ≥ i with ψ true at j, and φ true at all positions k with i ≤ k < j
explanation: Until requires a future witness j where ψ holds, with φ holding continuously up to (but not necessarily including) j. Choice 0 swaps the roles of φ and ψ. Choice 1 describes G φ with ψ failing (strong until requires ψ to eventually hold). Choice 2 ignores the 'until' structure entirely.
